(a) A daily close above upper pin resistance ($4,296.24) would invalidate the current bearish bias.
(b) A sustained decline in nominal 2-year Treasury yields that drags real yields significantly lower would lift rate pressure.
(c) A sudden surge in WTI crude oil back toward $95.28 that elevates breakeven inflation expectations would shift the macro lean.
(d) Direct BOJ currency intervention or an explicit rate hike forcing a systemic USD/JPY carry unwind would trigger safe-haven flows into gold.

*This analysis is to inform a decision, not investment advice.*
